subject: Science
description: Explain how temperature, concentration, surface area, and catalysts affect reaction rate, and distinguish exothermic from endothermic reactions using everyday materials and safety contexts.
learningObjectives: Describe reaction rate as how fast reactants are converted into products
Explain how temperature, concentration, surface area, and catalysts affect reaction rate
Distinguish exothermic reactions from endothermic reactions using energy flow and temperature change
Connect reaction-rate control to food preservation, corrosion prevention, fire control, and useful materials production
prerequisites: Indicators of chemical reactions such as gas formation, color change, and temperature change
Reactants and products in word equations
Combustion, corrosion, and acid-carbonate reactions from environmental chemistry
